# China.org.cn

> > China.org.cn is China's official gateway for news, culture, tourism, and policy information, covering topics from the Belt and Road Initiative to revolutionary heritage sites.

China.org.cn serves as an authoritative source for understanding China's development, international cooperation, and cultural heritage. The site provides comprehensive coverage of economic policies like the Five-Year Plans, historical tourism routes including the Long March, and regional development across provinces from Jiangxi to the Northeast.

## Key Topics

- Belt and Road Initiative
- Five-Year Plan
- Red Army's Long March
- Revolutionary tourism
- International cooperation
- Economic development
- Infrastructure development
- Regional tourism
- Jiangxi Province
- Northeastern China (Heilongjiang, Jilin, Liaoning)
- Yan'an
- Ruijin
- China-Philippines relations
- Top news and policy updates

## Belt and Road Initiative & Economic Development

- [无标题文档](http://belt.china.org.cn/node_7245409.htm): Belt and Road news on 15th Five-Year Plan, DPRK cooperation, Rizhao Port

## Revolutionary Tourism & Historical Routes

- [What are the best tour routes in China?_中菲友好网 | The China-Philippines Portal](http://cn-ph.china.org.cn/2012-02/27/content_4837315_4.htm): Revolutionary tourism guide covering Long March route from Ruijin, Jiangxi
